# Ryan Madhuwala (RAWx18)

> AI Infrastructure Engineer, open-source maintainer, and founder building Caracal at Garudex Labs. Youngest-ever Linux Foundation Lab Leader. Backed by GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel & Founders, Inc. Based in Ahmedabad, India.

Portfolio: https://ryanmadhuwala.tech

## About

- Engineer / Artist. Loves building, breaking, and shipping things.
- AI, open source, and developer tools.
- Third-year BTech dropout from IIIT Gwalior (Computer Science, 2023-2025, CGPA 7.8, JEE 99.1 percentile). Chose the market over the classroom for a two-year head start building a startup.
- Cohort Member: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund, Microsoft for Startups, Vercel Open Source Program Spring'26.
- LFX Mentor under LF Decentralized Trust. Ex-DRDO (Defense Ministry of India).
- Speaker/attendee: Open Source Summit Korea/Japan 2025 & India 2026, OpenSearchCon Korea/Europe 2025, GitHub Maintainer Summit 2026.
- Winner: Smart India Hackathon 2026. Finalist: Walmart Sparkathon 2025. Co-organizer: OpenSearch User Group Ahmedabad.

## Projects

- [Caracal](https://ryanmadhuwala.tech/projects/caracal): Authority, not credentials, for AI agents — policy-approved actions, delegation that can only narrow, instant revocation, tamper-evident audit. Live at https://www.caracal.run. Stack: Go, TypeScript, Python, Docker, OPA, Kubernetes, Terraform, Better Auth, Azure, AWS, Redis, PostgreSQL.
- [GitMesh](https://ryanmadhuwala.tech/projects/gitmesh): Capacity-aware product intelligence layer for engineering teams (acquired). Repo: https://github.com/LF-Decentralized-Trust-labs/gitmesh. Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue, Python, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS.
